title: interpretation
description: Produced by the synthesis layer. As of schema 0.2 the model fills a single free-text `interpretation` field (1-3 sentences supporting the dominant-biology call, folding in cell-state localization and condition dynamics where relevant) in place of the former `one_line_summary` / `cell_state` / `condition_dynamics` / `metadata_associations` fields. `confidence` still separates the model's raw score from the (currently shelved) fused final score; `provenance` is required and attached by the synthesis orchestrator, never filled by the model.

dominant_biology.description: the main program, as a short label

interpretation.description: 1-3 sentences of prose supporting the dominant-biology call, grounded in the cited fragments; folds in where the module is expressed and how its activity shifts across the tested condition where relevant

supporting_claims.description: every fragment_id cited here must exist in the module's packet and its direction must match (faithfulness invariant); may be empty only when flags includes insufficient_evidence

score.description: final confidence; equals model_score while the deterministic fusion is shelved (Part 4.5)

model_score.description: the model's raw self-reported confidence, preserved for audit

review.description: optional (schema 0.3): the structured self-review an agent labelling run (export_agent_workspace(mode = 'label')) attaches; LLM synthesis never fills it

evidence_tier.description: the tier that carried the call: hub_genes (primary), geneset_enrichment (secondary, only when hub genes are uninformative), technical_artifact (the artifact gate decided the label), or insufficient

status.description: technical: the module is a technical or sample-restricted signature (e.g. dissociation stress, patient-restricted) and gets a technical label

supporting_hubs.description: hub genes that support the label, each with its kME in this module; must be among the module's top 25 hubs by kME

expected_markers.description: the canonical markers the proposed label implies (obligate partners included); present means the gene is a member of this module

contradicting_evidence.description: evidence against the label, including absent expected markers

confidence_level.description: anchored rubric level; confidence.score must fall inside its band

display_hubs.description: three genes for figure annotation: from the top 10 hubs by kME, congruent with the label, no housekeeping normalizers, no two from the same gene family

provenance.description: attached by the synthesis orchestrator, never filled by the model
